# tomswallapi_tunnel (Resource)

A VPN tunnel definition on a device (allows encapsulated traffic).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tomswallapi_tunnel" "site_b" {
  device   = "fw1"
  type     = "ipsec"
  zone     = "net"
  gateways = ["203.0.113.20"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device` (String) Owning device.
- `type` (String) Tunnel type (ipsec, openvpn:udp, ...).
- `zone` (String) Zone the remote tunnel endpoint is in.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) Free-form comment.
- `gateway_zones` (List of String) Zones the remote gateway may be in.
- `gateways` (List of String) Remote gateway addresses.
- `port` (Number) Port the tunnel uses, overriding the type default.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by the server-assigned numeric id.
terraform import tomswallapi_tunnel.site_b 42
```
